assistantMessages.text: mere gehu mein keeda lag gaya

🐛 Keeda: Gehun ka Tana Chhedak (Stem Borer) ya Gunda (Aphids) ho sakta hai
⚠️ Khatra: Thoda
🌱 Kya hua: Gehu ki fasal mein koi keeda lag gaya hai, jiski wajah se fasal ko nuksaan ho raha hai.
✅ Kya karo: Sabse pehle, khet mein jaakar dekho ki keeda kahan aur kitna zyada hai. | Agar chhota keeda hai (jaise laal/kaale), toh neem tel (5 ml per litre paani) ka chhidkaav karo. | Agar zyada nuksaan hai, toh kisi local agriculture expert ya KVK se milkar sahi dawai ka naam pata karo.
💊 Dawa: Neem Tel (shuruaati ilaaj ke liye)
Dhaan me paani kab dena hai?

Fasal: Dhaan (Paddy/Rice)
Kab paani: Jab khet mein 1 inch paani hamesha bana rahe, khaas kar jadd banane aur mitti mein daana bharne ke samay. Paani sukhne na dein.
Kitna paani: Khet mein lagbhag 2 se 5 inch tak paani bana rehna chahiye, lekin zyada bharaav bhi na ho.
Tips: Jab dhaan lagane ke baad 7 din tak paani na dein, phir halka paani dein. | Jab phool nikalne waale hon, us samay khet mein paani hamesha bana rahe. | Paani kam hone par fasal sukh sakti hai, isliye hamesha check karte rahein.
